purpose: Twelfth-pass official and first-party verification for five existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction pages, first-party operator pages, Companies House records and current local-authority pages are promoted. A registered office or live service route supports identity and activity but does not prove an executed lease, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: Units 1-3 and 17-19 Salisbury Square Industrial Estate, Nottingham, NG7 2AB
rows.resolved_fact: Companies House continues to record TIFFORA LTD, formerly ECOMBIZZ LTD, as active at Unit 1 and records CASPER-I LTD as active at Unit 3 with a confirmation statement filed on 4 March 2026. NOTTINGHAM REG PLATES LIMITED is also active at Unit 18, one of the subject units. These records materially strengthen current exact-unit business identity across the industrial estate, but registered-office evidence does not prove every occupational lease or the complete current tenancy schedule for Units 1-3 and 17-19.

rows.address: Swan House, New Haven Terrace, Grimsby, DN31 2SD
rows.resolved_fact: North East Lincolnshire Council's March 2026 article confirms Swan House remains an operating council-leased supported-accommodation service, identifies residents living there in late 2025 and confirms Humbercare support at the building. The council's current homelessness page also lists Humbercare at Swan House Allotment. Current service operation is therefore reconfirmed well after the 2024 opening, while the executed ten-year lease and exact title geometry remain unread.

Newboulds & Co's current first-party site continues to publish its operating office at 4 Station Approach with live sales and lettings services. Companies House records NEWBOULDS & CO LIMITED as active at the exact address and shows accounts to 30 April 2025 filed on 26 September 2025. Current operator identity and activity are strong, but the auction lease term ending in June 2026 means any renewal, holding-over arrangement or replacement lease remains unread.

rows.address: 139-145 Lichfield Street, Walsall, West Midlands, WS1 1SE
rows.resolved_fact: STARTING POINT RECRUITMENT LIMITED remains active at 139-145 Lichfield Street with accounts to March 2025. Companies House now records active 145 HOLDINGS LIMITED at the same exact address as the tenant's controlling person with 75 percent or more ownership and voting rights. This verifies the tenant's current corporate-control route after the auction, but it does not cure the separate risk arising from the auction-named guarantor Steps To Work being in liquidation or prove the executed guarantee and lease terms.

KOKORO's current first-party locations page identifies the operating number 5 restaurant as GL1 2AH with live opening hours, while Companies House records active TELECARE LIMITED at number 7 using GL1 2AN from March 2025. The earlier whole-property postcode conflict is therefore explained by unit-level addressing rather than evidence that the number 5 operator is false. However, Acuitus names FT Enterprises London Limited as the number 7 tenant, so TELECARE's current exact-address company record introduces an unresolved assignment, subletting or registered-office-only question.
